name: SurfaceEffect
whenToUse: Feature and pricing cards on a landing page: a glow under the pointer (`spotlight`), a light running round the border of the plan you recommend (`beam`), a gentle `tilt`, `shine` or `lift` on hover.
`Aurora`: a slow color field behind a hero.

whenNotToUse.text: Cards in product UI (lists, dashboards, settings)
A way to say “this one is selected” or “this is clickable”
whenNotToUse.instead: Card selectable / action — the effect is decoration only

whenNotToUse.text: Several different effects on one page

anatomy.description: wraps the card; give it the card’s radius (`rounded-*`) so the effect is clipped to it.
a pseudo-element or CSS variables; no extra DOM in the card’s own content.
separate, as the first child of a `relative isolate` section.

do.caption: One accent on the one card that matters.

dont.caption: A different effect on every card: nothing stands out any more.

a11y: Decoration only: no role, no focus stop, nothing announced; Aurora is aria-hidden.
Pointer effects (spotlight, tilt) do nothing on touch screens, so nothing depends on them.
prefers-reduced-motion: no movement; the beam becomes a plain border.
Keep text over Aurora at full contrast: a solid surface under the copy, or the subtle intensity.

components.name: Aurora
components.description:
Motion preset (landing pages): a slow drifting aurora of brand colors
behind a hero (Kinetics' Aurora Drift). Place it as the first child of
a `relative isolate` section; it fills it and stays behind the content.
Decorative and hidden from assistive tech; still under
prefers-reduced-motion. Keep text on top of it at full contrast — put
copy on a solid surface or keep `intensity` low.
